title: Week 12 AM report
body: Before 6 PM MT tonight: add JAX D/ST, drop LAR, start JAX (LAR locks). Start Judkins + Evans, bench Dowdle/Tyson. Add Aaron Jones, drop Kiner. Jacobs ~10%; if IR blocks adds, move him to bench and drop Allen.

title: Flash: Evans and Diggs Questionable
body: Before 6 PM MT: add JAX D/ST, drop LAR. Start Judkins over Dowdle. Evans (rest DNP) and Diggs (excused absence) are Q; keep both for now, Tyson is the pivot. Decide on Friday's statuses.

title: Week 12 PM report
body: JAX D/ST is gone: add CIN D/ST ($0), drop LAR, start CIN before 6:00 PM MT (LAR locks). Start Judkins over Dowdle. Jacobs inactive, keep on IR. Evans/Diggs Q: start both, Tyson pivot; decide on Friday statuses.

title: Flash: Jacobs officially Out
body: Jacobs now Out (already known): leave on IR. LAR D/ST locked in, CIN swap missed. Start Judkins over Dowdle before Fri DEN@PIT (High). WR plan unchanged: Evans/Diggs Sun, Tyson pivot.

title: Week 12 AM report
body: Start Judkins over Dowdle before Fri 1 PM MT. Swap Evans in for Tyson (Evans' DNP was routine rest; Purdy ankle is a risk). Goff/Bates lock 11 AM MT today, no change. Tyson is the Sunday pivot.

title: Flash: Diggs cleared
body: Diggs no longer Q, so keep him in. Judkins is now starting (fixed). Keep Moore tonight. Swap Evans in for Tyson before Sun 11 AM MT unless Friday downgrades Evans.

title: Game day: Thursday night
body: Start Evans over DJ Moore before 6:20 PM MT (KC @ BUF lock). Heavy rain in Buffalo; Evans limited Thu; Diggs cleared. WRs: Diggs, Tyson, Evans. If Evans is Doubtful/Out Friday, start Allen.

title: Week 12 PM report
body: Before 6:20 PM MT: start Evans over DJ Moore (Moore active, heavy rain in BUF). Medium. If Evans Doubtful/Out Fri, start Allen. Optional: add Aaron Jones ($0) for Kiner.

title: Week 12 AM report
body: Start Evans over Tyson at WR2 before Sun 11 AM MT (Medium). Keep Tyson if SF lists Evans Doubtful/Out today; Allen is the 4:25 pivot. Optional: add Aaron Jones for Kiner, start over Mason. Moore had 2-15.

title: Flash: Omar Cooper Jr. ruled out
body: Cooper (bench) is Out vs MIA, no lineup change. Still swap Evans in for Tyson before Sun 11 AM MT unless SF lists Evans Doubtful/Out today. Optional: cut Cooper or Kiner for Aaron Jones.
